_comment: Reviewed negative for the frozen 12-site D3 contract pilot. Candidate sets are retained as evidence, never promoted to universal membership invariants.

pilot.selection_query: first 8 predecessor compiled-C table_backed D3 sites, then first 4 still-unselected D3 sites; ascending pc then image/id within each tranche

protected_set.definition: 58 source-pinned KNOWN_WRITERS, all 124 resolved window-touching instruction sites, and four closure-root entries

writer_set.question: can any unresolved store in the 21-image census write [0x8007fbc4,0x8007fbc8)
writer_set.meaning: 4266 unresolved store sites, including 2244 full-width stores, remain possible writers of the dispatch cell; direct hits are a lower bound, not a census

table_membership_invariant.reason: 4266 unresolved stores across 21 images, including 2244 full-width stores, retain undecided effective addresses relative to the cell

protected_set_disjointness.authority: candidate/observed-set arithmetic only; this does not prove the dispatch membership set is complete

runtime.meaning: silence cannot close the writer or value universe

shared_dispatch_cell_0x8007fbc4.immunity_to_missing_reaching_definitions: No proof is accepted: the region writer residual is carried as part of the premise, so the known direct writer cannot be promoted to a census.
shared_dispatch_cell_0x8007fbc4.why_shape: a sound region-sensitive alias/writer engine could bound all 4266 stores away from the cell or prove their stored value domains
shared_dispatch_cell_0x8007fbc4.named_prerequisite: complete shared-cell alias and writer-value closure

runtime_observed_targets.authority: observation only; 1286 instances and 10 observed PCs are not a universal field domain

typed_state_owner_binding.verdict: rejected: mover_updater's s0 at 0x8004d5e0 is not uniformly loaded from one address | writer value domain: non-null writer 0x80049c10 only preserves a same-table content invariant that is not yet proved | table-writer universe is not proved exhaustive: 5012 store(s) across 21 images retain undecided effective addresses relative to 0x80090748. Neither a conditional same-table induction nor a known six-writer lower bound closes Item 2

table_membership_invariant.reason: no exhaustive actor +0x7C writer/type invariant exists

protected_set_disjointness.authority: candidate/observed-set arithmetic only; this does not prove the dispatch membership set is complete

object_field_provenance.immunity_to_missing_reaching_definitions: Observed handlers are not treated as the field domain; acceptance requires a type invariant and an exhaustive region writer bound.
object_field_provenance.why_shape: interprocedural object-region typing plus field-sensitive writer closure could prove the domain, but the retained ABI ledger knows only 1/867 consumed argument domains

entry_scoped_candidate.scope: all paths reachable from the declared extent entry; external interior-entry exclusion remains a separate consumer gate

table_membership_or_named_exception_inva.reason: both C implementations begin at owner entry 0x80060C64; no global ingress contract excludes an indirect transfer directly to 0x80060C78

protected_set_disjointness.authority: candidate/observed-set arithmetic only; this does not prove the dispatch membership set is complete

bios_ingress_exception.immunity_to_missing_reaching_definitions: The locally dominating immediate is explicitly not promoted across unknown interior ingress; a global vector/ingress bound is a separate premise.
bios_ingress_exception.why_shape: a sound whole-program ingress/vector contract could exclude interior entry and promote the already-agreed B0 exception, but that contract is absent
bios_ingress_exception.named_prerequisite: complete indirect-ingress and BIOS/vector exception contract

dynamic_module_boundary.why_required_despite_zero_sample_sites: the work order names the loader boundary as a separate D3-enabling contract; it is not credited toward the 12-site gate

fmv_records.name: allocated_block_0
fmv_records.valid_domain: allocation result; freed once in player teardown

residency_alias_warning.meaning: 0x800CABE0 is code-shaped under the frontend observation but data under FMV.BIN residency; a raw address cannot identify the loaded module

loader_membership_invariant.reason: the retained corpus lacks per-hit residency and transfer provenance, and no loader-byte contract binds the modules that may occupy the range

protected_set_disjointness.authority: candidate/observed-set arithmetic only; this does not prove the dispatch membership set is complete

dynamic_module_boundary.immunity_to_missing_reaching_definitions: Runtime targets and pristine slots are not treated as the loaded-module universe; module identity and loader writes must be proved independently.
dynamic_module_boundary.why_shape: a finite loader/module census joined to per-transfer residency semantics could establish the contract; the current retained tuple schema cannot
dynamic_module_boundary.named_prerequisite: loader byte contract plus retained residency/transfer identity

decision.explicit_sentence: NO-GO: 0/4 contracts are fully established and 0/12 frozen D3 sites clear both membership and protected-set disjointness; the GO thresholds require at least 1/4 and at least 3/12.

soundness_halt.meaning: No accepted proof exists to falsify. Candidate/observed sets have zero protected intersections, but are not promoted as complete domains.

sixth_attempt_funding.plain_statement: A technical avenue remains only through new prerequisite engines: region-sensitive alias closure, field-sensitive object typing, a global ingress contract, or a loader/residency contract. Another target-enumeration campaign using the current machinery is not funded by this result.
